reviews.text: Me ha encantado esta ampolla. Es perfecta para calmar la piel sensible o irritada de forma inmediata. Tiene una textura súper ligera que se absorbe rapidísimo sin dejar sensación pesada ni pegajosa. Mantiene la piel muy bien hidratada y ayuda mucho a reducir rojeces. ¡Totalmente recomendada y volveré a comprarla sin duda!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款安瓶精華。佢啱即時舒緩敏感或者刺激嘅皮膚。質地超級輕盈，吸收快到不得了，唔會留低厚重或者黏膩嘅感覺。佢令皮膚保持水潤，又有助減少紅位。非常推薦，我一定會再買！

reviews.text:
i started using it during a period when my skin was getting irritated really easily, and the first thing I noticed was how simple it felt. The texture is lightweight, slightly watery, and absorbs really quickly without leaving any sticky feeling behind.
most was how calming it was. Whenever my skin looked red or felt sensitive, I'd use this and my face would just feel more comfortable. It's not one of those products where you wake up the next day looking completely different, but over time I noticed my skin looked less angry and more balanced.

I also love that it layers well with everything. Some ampoules can feel heavy or pill under other products, but this one just disappears into the skin. I've used it morning and night without any issues.

The thing that really sold me was how reliable it is. Whenever I tried something new and my skin started complaining, I'd go back to this and my skin always seemed happier.
reviews.zh:
我喺一段皮膚好容易受刺激嘅時期開始用呢款，我第一個留意到嘅，係佢感覺好簡單。質地輕盈，微微似水，吸收好快，用完唔會留低黏膩感。
最令我印象深刻嘅係佢好舒緩。每當我皮膚睇落發紅或者感覺敏感嗰時，我用呢款，面部就會感覺更加舒服。佢唔係嗰種第二日醒嚟就即時變咗另一個人嘅產品，但係隨住時間過去，我留意到皮膚睇落冇咁惱火，亦更加平衡。

我仲好鍾意佢同其他嘢疊用都好好。有啲安瓶會好重，或者喺其他產品底下會起搓，但係呢款就即刻滲入皮膚。我朝晚都用，冇出現任何問題。

真正令我信服嘅係佢嘅可靠性。每當我試新嘢，而我嘅皮膚開始抗議嗰時，我就會返返去用呢款，而我嘅皮膚都似乎會開心啲。

reviews.text:
ayant une peau normal desydratée , assez sensible , la marque beplain en général est génial pour ma peau . 
Ce sérum hydrate profondément ma peau sans jamais l'agresser . 
Il a une texture légère qui pénètre facilement la peau , et qui est agréable en été comme en hiver. 
Je ne m'en passe plus !
reviews.zh:
我嘅皮膚係正常但缺水，都幾敏感，beplain 呢個品牌一般對我嘅皮膚都好正。
呢款精華可以深層補水，唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。
佢質地輕盈，容易滲入皮膚，夏天同冬天用都好舒服。
我已經離唔開佢啦！

reviews.text:
I have been using this serum for several months now, and I find it very hydrating and calming. 

At first I wast sure if I'd like it as much as the Cosrx Cica Serum (one of my overall favourite skincare products), but I have come to enjoy it even more due to the lower viscosity. 

I'm definitely repurchasing!
reviews.zh:
我用呢款精華已經幾個月，我覺得佢好補水、好舒緩。

一開始我唔肯定自己會唔會似鍾意 Cosrx Cica Serum（我整體最鍾意嘅護膚產品之一）咁鍾意呢款，但係因為佢黏稠度較低，我反而愈嚟愈鍾意。

我一定會再買！

reviews.text: Il correspond bien aux peaux sensibles, mais j'avoue ne pas avoir forcément vu d'effet sur ma peau. Sachant également que j'ai quelques cicatrices d'acné donc il n'était pas forcément adapté à ma problématique. Mais il est bien apaisant
reviews.zh: 佢幾啱敏感皮膚，但係我要承認，我唔一定見到對我皮膚有效果。另外，我有啲暗瘡疤痕，所以佢未必啱我嘅問題。不過佢幾舒緩。

reviews.text: I’ve been using this ampoule for a while, and while it seems to work, I haven’t noticed significant benefits yet. It might take more time to see results. On the bright side, it didn’t irritate my skin, which is a plus. If you’re patient, it could be worth trying, but don’t expect immediate results.its non greasy absorbs immediately
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款安瓶一段時間，雖然睇落好似有效，但係我未見到明顯嘅好處。可能要多啲時間先見到效果。正面嘅係，佢冇刺激我嘅皮膚，呢點係加分位。如果你有耐性，可以試吓，但係唔好期望即時見效。質地唔油膩，吸收得快。

reviews.text: ce serum a une étoile en moins parce que c'est une texture très fluide donc pour moi qui applique directement sur mon visage il coule juste comme de l'eau et ce n'est pas très pratique, le bon point pour moi c'est qu'il n'a pas d'odeur, sinon il apaise très bien ma peau, je peux vite être rouge a cause du soleil et de la pollution et ce sérum l'apaise très bien, je l'applique matin et soir, il s'allie très bien a la crème à l'escargot que j'aime beaucoup, je le recommande mais il ne fonctionne pas plus sur les rougeurs que n'importe quel autre sérum, j'en ai essayé plusieurs et celui là est juste le moins pratique à appliquer a cause de sa texture.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華我扣咗一粒星，因為佢質地好稀，所以對我呢個直接塗喺面上嘅人嚟講，佢就咁流走，好似水咁，唔係好方便。好處係佢冇味，另外佢幫我舒緩皮膚都幾好。我好容易因為太陽同空氣污染而泛紅，呢款精華幫我舒緩得好好。我早晚都用，同我好鍾意嘅蝸牛面霜配合得好好。我推薦，但係佢喺紅位方面嘅效果，同其他任何精華冇分別。我試過好多款，呢款只係最唔方便塗，因為質地嘅關係。

reviews.text: sad that it is now out of stock as im running out of it. it is soooo good. i like the simple ingredient list and i am all for centella as my skin is sensitive so i love the refreshing and soothing calming effects. this is all good. i love it. my combo skin loves it. especially good for night time as it really does give a refreshing calming feeling
reviews.zh: 好可惜佢而家缺貨，我快冇咗。佢真係好好。我好鍾意佢簡單嘅成分表，而且我好支持積雪草，因為我皮膚敏感，所以我好鍾意佢清爽、舒緩嘅效果。一切都好好。我好鍾意佢。我嘅混合性皮膚都好鍾意。特別適合晚上用，因為佢真係帶嚟清爽、平靜嘅感覺。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
